evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the 8004 vault ceremony and escrow lifecycle were sent with the lab wallet through tests/devnet/atlantid-programs.mjs. Creating a new vault in the console still needs a prior official-8004 register_with_options.
